title: Solved-LP1 dollar segments align with operation frames
claim: Across the fifteen rune-bearing solved LP1 pages, all seven source dollar segments are operation-homogeneous and their six boundaries exactly equal the six established operation-change gaps; one of 3,003 six-boundary placements has that property.
why_it_matters: It supports treating the dollar boundary as an operation-scope boundary and prevents automatic cipher-state resets at every internal record or page.
controls: Already-solved LP1 pages and established operators only.
Independent derivation of source boundaries and operation changes from the public ledger.
limitations: The claim is structural and restricted to solved LP1.
Complete third-party LP1 transcriptions and images are not redistributed.
The observation identifies scope boundaries, not the operation selector for an unsolved segment.
does_not_claim: That every LP2 segment uses an LP1 operation.
That a dollar boundary alone identifies which operation to apply.
That internal red records have no independent semantic or type role.
current_interpretation: Use dollar boundaries as the default operation-frame boundary in the HMS runtime while keeping operation selection and LP2 transfer as separately gated questions.
